What Is Fat Grafting Surgery?

Fat grafting surgery, also known as fat transfer, is a cosmetic procedure that uses your own fat to restore volume, improve contours, and rejuvenate areas that have lost fullness due to ageing, weight loss or genetics.

Key Benefits

  • Uses your own natural fat
  • Achieves natural and long-lasting results
  • Restores volume and youthful contours
  • Minimally invasive with quick recovery
  • Suitable for facial and body areas

Are You a Suitable Candidate?

  • ✓ You have areas of volume loss on face or body.
  • ✓ You are in good overall health.
  • ✓ You have realistic expectations.
  • ✓ You want natural-looking enhancement using your own fat.
  • ✓ You are looking for a minimally invasive and safe procedure

All procedure details and recovery protocols are clinically verified by Dr. Girish A C.

Our Process

1

Consultation

Discuss your concerns, medical history and aesthetic goals.

2

Personalised Plan

A customised treatment plan is created based on your facial or body areas and desired outcome.

3

Fat Harvesting

Fat is gently removed from donor areas such as abdomen, thighs or flanks using liposuction.

4

Fat Purification & Grafting

The harvested fat is purified and carefully injected into the target areas for natural and even results.

5

Recovery & Follow-up

You will receive post-operative guidance and regular follow-ups to ensure optimal results.

Recovery Timeline

First 24-48 Hours

Mild swelling, bruising and discomfort are common. Keep the treated areas clean and follow post-operative instructions.

Around Day 3-5

Swelling and bruising start to reduce and normal activities can be resumed.

Weeks 2-4

Most swelling subsides and initial results start to become visible.

✨

Final Results

The final results are usually visible within 3-6 months as the grafted fat settles and integrates naturally.
